cohort: The study included a weighted sample of 31,640 women with children less than 2 months of age across East Africa.
finding: Home delivery, cesarean section, poor wealth status, poor media access, maternal age 35-49 years, and distance problems accessing health facilities were associated with delayed breastfeeding initiation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as a factor associated with delayed breastfeeding initiation.
cross-section timing: Data from Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) collected between 2011 and 2021, focusing on mothers with children less than 2 months of age.
